100% of Malaysian licensed financing company Firstborn Top Capital.
Following the transaction, ARCL plans to rename itself BlueCrest Investment and list on Nasdaq Global Market under ticker “BCIN.”
The deal implies a pro forma enterprise value of approximately $1.09B, assuming $5M in PIPE financing and no redemptions from ARCL’s $120.8M trust account.
Firstborn Top Capital provides financing to individuals and corporations, with offerings spanning vehicle, property, personal, working-capital, capex, M&A and loan-consolidation financing.
The combined company intends to use transaction proceeds for market expansion, lending infrastructure and marketing capabilities.
Existing Firstborn Top Capital shareholders are expected to own 82.39% of the combined company, while public investors are expected to hold about 12.4%.
The transaction has been approved by both companies’ boards but still requires ARCL shareholder approval.
The transaction is currently expected to close in Q1 2027.

title: ARC Group Acquisition I announces $1.09B BlueCrest deal
